title: Secure Enclave Anti-Replay Tokens (ART/xART) & Monotonic Storage Specification

art.name: Internal Anti-Replay Token (ART)
art.storage_medium: Dedicated high-endurance NOR flash within the SEP power island (Effaceable Storage).

structure.epoch_id: Monotonically increasing 64-bit counter tracking storage generations.
structure.payload_hash: SHA-384 digest of the active keybag and credential state table.
structure.hmac_signature: HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated using internal hardware UID key.

art.validation_protocol: During boot (AppleSEPARTStorage::start), sepOS loads ART tokens, recalculates the HMAC using silicon UID, and aborts boot if state mismatch is detected.

xart.name: External Anti-Replay Token (xART / Gigalocker)
xart.storage_medium: Encrypted persistent partition in primary NAND flash managed by AppleSEPXART driver.
xart.encryption: AES-256-XTS with ephemeral session keys negotiated via ASCwrap mailbox.
xart.synchronization: Batched journal commits. When a credential or keybag updates, sepOS issues cmsgXART_SYNC_GIGALOCKER.

monotonic_otp_counters.role: Prevents OS/firmware downgrade attacks (anti-rollback). Each major sepOS release permanently burns next bit.

nonce_generators.role: Boot challenge nonce preventing replay of restore Image4 firmware manifests.
Session transaction nonce invalidating replayed mailbox packets.
